subject: Consolidation RFP: Intercom / Zendesk / Gainsight — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP for support tooling consolidation (Intercom/Zendesk/Gainsight)

Team —

As we discussed in last week's ops review, it's time to evaluate a consolidation strategy for our support & CS stack. Current drivers: rising seat/license spend, inconsistent routing (Intercom for chat, Zendesk for tickets), and limited account health visibility in Gainsight.

Attached is a draft RFP that outlines scope: agent seats, chat routing, enterprise SSO/KMS, integration cadence with our data warehouse, and a 12‑month cost comparison. Please review the sections relevant to your teams and flag any must-have items by EOW (Friday).

Key asks:
- Marissa: operational requirements and escalation playbook
- Ben: integrations & webhooks (what will break if we consolidate?)
- Laura: procurement/finance constraints and preferred contracting terms
- Evelyn: data residency/KMS + SOC2 gaps we must call out to vendors

I'll coordinate vendor calls next week (Zendesk/Intercom/Gainsight + our partner integrator).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20261027-support-tools-rfp.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP for support tooling consolidation (Intercom/Zendesk/Gainsight)

Thanks Karthik — reviewed the RFP. A few ops notes inline:

- Must have: unified SLA-based routing for enterprise customers (>=99.5% first response for platinum).
- We need a funnel for async support handoffs (chat->ticket->CS) with preserved conversation context (including attachments).
- Reporting: daily SLA exceptions for L2 on-call, and a shared incident timeline export for SEs.

Ben: I'm going to add a short doc with the webhook events we rely on — please confirm if any are non-negotiable.

Marissa
VP, Customer Support
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 09:12, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Karthik — will dig into integrations. Quick flag: our live transcript exporter calls Intercom v2 webhooks and Zendesk's ticket import is used by the ingestion pipeline. If we standardize on one vendor we'll need a migration window and attachment rehydration plan.
>
> —Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Zendesk Sales <sales@zendesk.com>, Intercom Renewals <renewals@intercom.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Request for capability confirmation + short discovery call (Redwood Inference)

Hi team —

We're running a short RFP to evaluate consolidation options across chat, ticketing, and CSM tooling. Attached is a one‑page summary (also shared in Drive). Can you confirm the following by EOD Mon: 1) Support for incremental agent license migration, 2) Attachment rehydration APIs, 3) SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning SSO, and 4) Data export formats for customer health exports?

We'd like to schedule 45m discovery calls next week (Nov 2–3). Please propose slots.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Support Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_comparison_sheet.xlsx

From: Zendesk Sales <sales@zendesk.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for capability confirmation + short discovery call (Redwood Inference)

Hi Ben — great to connect on this. Quick answers inline:

1) Incremental license migration: supported via staged seat activation (we can map Intercom agents to Zendesk roles).
2) Attachment rehydration: yes — we provide an attachments API and migration partner guides (we've done 3 migrations in the past 18 months).
3) SAML + SCIM: supported; we also offer a dedicated SSO onboarding specialist for enterprise plans.
4) Customer health exports: we can deliver CSV/JSON dumps; Gainsight connector exists for account signals.

Proposed slots for discovery call (Nov 2): 10:00–10:45 PT or 15:00–15:45 PT.

Attached our enterprise pricing summary; note license tiers vary by seat type.

Best,
Priya Anand
Enterprise Sales, Zendesk

Attachment: zendesk-pricing-proposal.pdf

From: Intercom Renewals <renewals@intercom.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for capability confirmation + short discovery call (Redwood Inference)

Thanks Ben — we can support staged migration but some features (e.g., rich message routing by user segments) are platform‑specific. We do offer a migration toolkit; attachments are supported but vendor migration is typically handled via our partners.

We have a slot Nov 2, 11:00–11:45 PT if that works.

—Samir Khan
Renewals, Intercom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Zendesk Sales <sales@zendesk.com>, Intercom Renewals <renewals@intercom.com>, Gainsight Solutions <solutions@gainsight.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for capability confirmation + short discovery call (Redwood Inference)

Thanks everyone for the quick responses — appreciate the clarity.

Next steps on our side:
- Marissa, Ben, Laura, Evelyn and I will run an internal discovery on Nov 3 to map must-haves vs nice-to-haves.
- Kicking off vendor calls Nov 4–5 (we'll confirm exact times).
- Procurement ask: pricing must include a 90‑day migration SLA, step-up seats for the first 3 months, and a written data export guarantee.

Evelyn — please flag any legal/contract items we should surface before calls (data retention, KMS integration notes).

Posting the consolidated RFP and vendor slots to the Drive now.

Karthik
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
